content.comment_body: Hello, I am seeking advice for a project involving communication between a third-party HMI and a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. Is direct communication supported? If not, which [product_name] model would enable this functionality? Thank you!

The mentioned HMI supports the Modbus protocol. Thanks for your help!
